say:7:1521244006:1.source_cn: 我也不想被巴知道。那家伙的嘴一向不饶人。

say:8:1521244007:1.text: Hmph. You've got some spine, I'll give you that.

say:9:1521244008:1.text: What was the plan then? That beast wasn't going to show mercy.
say:9:1521244008:1.source_cn: 要是我们不来，你准备怎么对付刚才的暴兽？它可不是吃素的。

say:10:1521244009:1.text: I had one. If I didn't, I wouldn't be standing here.
say:10:1521244009:1.source_cn: 我自然有办法。否则就不会在武器脱手后还站在原地了。

choice_prompt:11:1521244009.text: I had one. If I didn't, I wouldn't be standing here.
choice_prompt:11:1521244009.source_cn: 我自然有办法。否则就不会在武器脱手后还站在原地了。

say:12:1521244010:1.source_cn: 暴兽有两个弱点。只要知道这两点，没有武器也能对付它。

say:13:1521244011:1.text:
First, their weak spot.
The <style="highlight">belly</style>, softest part of their body.
say:13:1521244011:1.source_cn: 第一个是它身体上的弱点。\n<style=highli...

say:14:1521244012:1.text:
Second, their behavior.
If <style="highlight">they think their prey is dead</style>, they drop their guard.

say:15:1521244013:1.text: So if you're losing in a fight with it, drop to the ground. Stay still. Let it relax. Then hit it in the belly where it's weakest.
say:15:1521244013:1.source_cn: 所以独自对战暴兽时，如果落了下风，只要看准时机倒地装死...

say:16:1521244014:1.text: You'll need to wait a while for it to drop its guard, but once it does, this trick always works.
say:16:1521244014:1.source_cn: 虽然等它完全放松需要一定时间，但这个方法几乎不可能失手。

say:17:1521244015:1.source_cn: 嗯……的确是很有趣的策略。

say:19:1521244017:1.text: Let's just say I've been on the wrong end of a beast or two.
say:19:1521244017:1.source_cn: 我有经验……呃，被暴兽袭击的经验。

say:20:1521244018:1.text: Back then, I wasn't much of a fighter. Barely knew what I was doing. I had to get creative just to stay alive.
say:20:1521244018:1.source_cn: 当时的我还不算是个成熟的战士，只能想点别的办法，至少保...

choice_prompt:21:1521244018.text: Back then, I wasn't much of a fighter. Barely knew what I was doing. I had to get creative just to stay alive.
choice_prompt:21:1521244018.source_cn: 当时的我还不算是个成熟的战士，只能想点别的办法，至少保住自己的命。

say:23:1521244020:1.text: Yeah. But luckily, it worked. And I learned where to strike.
say:23:1521244020:1.source_cn: 幸运的是，我赌赢了，还发现了它的弱点。
say:23:1521244020:1.male: Yeah. But luckily, it worked. And I learned where to strike.
say:23:1521244020:1.female: Yeah. But luckily, it worked. And I learned where to strike.

say:24:1521244021:1.text: A smart warrior learns their prey's habits in real combat. You turned the tide with sharp instincts. That's exactly the kind of fighter the Wildborn need.
say:24:1521244021:1.source_cn: 聪明的战士懂得在实战中摸清猎物的习性。你能逆风翻盘，全...

say:25:1521244022:1.text: But don't get cocky. You're still injured. Take this medicine.
say:25:1521244022:1.source_cn: 不过受了伤还是不能马虎。这些伤药你拿着吧。

say:27:1521244024:1.text: Thanks. I'll get back to the hunt and make good use of your medicine.
say:27:1521244024:1.source_cn: 那我就继续捕猎了，尽量不辜负这些伤药。

say:28:1521244025:0.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, time's almost up. We should <style="highlight">return to camp.</style>
say:28:1521244025:0.male: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, time's almost up. We should <style="highlight">return to camp.</style>
say:28:1521244025:0.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, time's almost up. We should <style="highlight">return to camp.</style>

say:29:1521244026:1.text: <style="highlight">Once night falls</style>, the others will be back with whatever they caught.
say:29:1521244026:1.male: <style="highlight">Once night falls</style>, the others will be back with whatever they caught.
say:29:1521244026:1.female: <style="highlight">Once night falls</style>, the others will be back with whatever they caught.

say:0:1521244501:0.text: Now we just wait at camp for the warriors to return.
say:0:1521244501:0.source_cn: 接下来只需返回营地，等待战士们归来。
say:0:1521244501:0.male: Now we just wait at camp for the warriors to return.
say:0:1521244501:0.female: Now we just wait at camp for the warriors to return.

say:0:1521245501:0.text: Looks like they brought in quite the haul. Let's see how everyone did.

say:0:1521245501:0.male: Looks like they brought in quite the haul. Let's see how everyone did.
say:0:1521245501:0.female: Looks like they brought in quite the haul. Let's see how everyone did.

say:2:1521246001:0.source_cn: 看来你的战利品不少，巴。

say:3:1521246002:0.text: Of course. Just look behind me. Mountains of beast carcasses. No one even comes close.
say:3:1521246002:0.source_cn: 当然。看看我身后堆成山的野兽尸体，谁能比我更多？

say:4:1521246003:0.text: Pretty sure I'm today's top hunter!
say:4:1521246003:0.source_cn: 不用想，今天的胜者肯定是我！

say:5:1521246004:0.text: Hold your horses. The winner hasn't been named yet.
say:5:1521246004:0.source_cn: 结果还没宣布，你高兴得太早了。

say:6:1521246005:0.text: Why don't you take a good look around? Solt's haul is just as big as yours—and unlike you, he didn't sabotage his teammates. You'll be penalized for that.
say:6:1521246005:0.source_cn: 也好好看看别人的成果，索斯的猎物堆得和你一样高。再想想...

say:7:1521246006:1.text: Tch. Fine, do what you want. It won't change anything.
say:7:1521246006:1.source_cn: 哼，你要算就算吧，算了又能怎么样？

say:8:1521246007:1.text: Just wait. The win is still mine!

say:2:1521247001:0.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>... I'm sorry. I didn't catch as much as the others...

say:2:1521247001:0.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>... I'm sorry. I didn't catch as much as the others...

choice_prompt:3:1521247001.male: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>... I'm sorry. I didn't catch as much as the others...
choice_prompt:3:1521247001.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>... I'm sorry. I didn't catch as much as the others...

say:4:1521247003:0.text: You're still young. No need to feel discouraged.
say:4:1521247003:0.source_cn: 你还年轻得很，用不着灰心。

say:5:1521247004:0.text: For a first-timer, you did great. With more experience, you'll only get better.
say:5:1521247004:0.source_cn: 第一次参加选拔就能抓到这么多野兽，挺不错。再历练几年，...

choice:3:0:1.text: It's fine. You did your best.
choice:3:0:1.male: It's fine. You did your best.
choice:3:0:1.female: It's fine. You did your best.

say:8:1521247002:0.text: I'm sorry. I let you down...
say:8:1521247002:0.male: I'm sorry. I let you down...
say:8:1521247002:0.female: I'm sorry. I let you down...

choice:3:1:2.source_cn: 看来我的魔法有点浪费了？

say:3:1521248002:0.source_cn: 对了，你手上的伤怎么样了？

say:5:1521248004:1.text: So who got more, me or Bel?
say:5:1521248004:1.source_cn: 我和巴那家伙，谁捕到的猎物更多？

choice_prompt:6:1521248004.text: So who got more, me or Bel?
choice_prompt:6:1521248004.source_cn: 我和巴那家伙，谁捕到的猎物更多？

say:7:1521248005:1.text: Still counting. We'll announce it soon. Be patient.
say:7:1521248005:1.source_cn: 正在清点呢，待会就公布结果，别着急。

say:8:1521248006:1.text: To be honest, I don't care about winning. I just want to beat Bel.
say:8:1521248006:1.source_cn: 能不能赢得选拔已经不要紧了，只要胜过巴就可以。

say:9:1521248007:1.text: Huh... didn't know you were that competitive.
say:9:1521248007:1.source_cn: 哈……真没看出来，原来你好胜心这么强。

choice:6:1:2.female: Looks like it's neck and neck!

say:3:1521249003:0.female: The results were a bit surprising... but not entirely unexpected.

choice_prompt:4:1521249003.female: The results were a bit surprising... but not entirely unexpected.

say:5:1521249004:0.female: Close, but Bel beat him by one.

say:6:1521249005:0.text: But like I said earlier, he'll be penalized for his actions. Attacking a teammate is a serious offense among the Wildborn!

say:7:1521249009:0.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, come with me. We'll <style="highlight">announce the results</style> together. You're the judge. If you're not there, they'll question everything I say.
say:7:1521249009:0.source_cn: 请和我一起去<style=highlight>公布最终...
say:7:1521249009:0.male: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, come with me. We'll <style="highlight">announce the results</style> together. You're the judge. If you're not there, they'll question everything I say.
say:7:1521249009:0.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, come with me. We'll <style="highlight">announce the results</style> together. You're the judge. If you're not there, they'll question everything I say.

say:9:1521249006:1.text: He did. Kid knows how to hunt, sure. But that ego of his... I don't like it one bit.
say:9:1521249006:1.source_cn: 巴的确有狩猎天赋。但正是因为这种天赋，他才这么自大。反...

say:9:1521249006:1.female: He did. Kid knows how to hunt, sure. But that ego of his... I don't like it one bit.

say:10:1521249007:1.text: If he ever wants to join my hunting squad, he'll have to grow up first.
say:10:1521249007:1.source_cn: 想进我的狩猎队，他还得多花几年磨磨性子。

say:10:1521249007:1.female: If he ever wants to join my hunting squad, he'll have to grow up first.

choice:4:1:2.text: So Bel actually got the most?
choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 不会是巴的猎物最多吧？
choice:4:1:2.male: So Bel actually got the most?
choice:4:1:2.female: So Bel actually got the most?

say:11:1521249008:1.text: Yeah. He just came of age. Still has a lot to learn.

say:11:1521249008:1.male: Yeah. He just came of age. Still has a lot to learn.
say:11:1521249008:1.female: Yeah. He just came of age. Still has a lot to learn.

choice:4:2:3.text: It's not Ruu, that's for sure.
choice:4:2:3.male: It's not Ruu, that's for sure.
choice:4:2:3.female: It's not Ruu, that's for sure.

say:1:1521250001:0.text: The results are in. The one with the most kills tonight is—
say:1:1521250001:0.source_cn: 经过清点，今晚猎物数量最多的人是——

say:5:1521250004:0.text: But the winner of today's tryout is... <style="highlight">Solt</style>!
say:5:1521250004:0.source_cn: 但是，这场选拔最后的胜者是——<style=highl...

say:11:1521250007:0.source_cn: 太好了！索斯要成为狩猎队的一员了！

say:13:1521250008:0.text: What? No way! That's not fair! I had the highest kill count!
say:13:1521250008:0.source_cn: 凭什么……这不公平！明明我才是猎物最多的那个人！

say:16:1521250009:0.text: Like I said before, we hunt as a team. The Wildborn stand as one! That's the first lesson every Wildborn warrior learns!
say:16:1521250009:0.source_cn: 我早说过，狩猎队是一个整体，整个雅库伯尔都是一个整体！...

say:17:1521250010:1.text: Anyone who joins the squad must understand—you're never fighting alone. You must always watch your teammates' backs.
say:17:1521250010:1.source_cn: 加入狩猎队的人，必须时刻牢记自己不是在孤军奋战！无论做...

say:18:1521250011:0.text: If you ignore a teammate in danger, you've failed! If you set traps to hurt one, that's worse. That's outright betrayal!
say:18:1521250011:0.source_cn: 如果同伴陷入危险，你们却没有及时施以援手，那就是失职，...

say:19:1521250012:0.text: And you, Bel, you failed on every front.
say:19:1521250012:0.source_cn: 而你，巴，你根本没有做到这一点。

say:20:1521250013:0.text: You mocked a teammate who got hurt because of you, then turned around and started a fight. I don't need someone like that on my squad.
say:20:1521250013:0.source_cn: 你不但出言嘲讽因你而受伤的伙伴，还和别人大打出手。我的...

say:21:1521250014:0.text: Tch... Say what you want, it's still not fair.
say:21:1521250014:0.source_cn: 哼……就算你说了这么多，那也是不公平！

say:22:1521250015:0.text: Solt threw punches too. Why aren't you punishing him?
say:22:1521250015:0.source_cn: 索斯也动手了，你为什么不罚他？！

say:23:1521250016:1.text: Because he stood up for a teammate. He fought for what was right. Why would I punish that?
say:23:1521250016:1.source_cn: 他是真正在帮助同伴、仗义执言的人，我为什么要罚他？

say:24:1521250017:1.text: A true warrior never lets his pride get in the way of his duty. If you think you're too strong to need allies, go hunt alone.
say:24:1521250017:1.source_cn: 一个真正优秀的战士永远不会允许自己的短视害了同伴。既然...

say:25:1521250018:1.text: Solt understands that. That's why he's earned his place in the hunting squad.
say:25:1521250018:1.source_cn: 索斯能做到这一点，所以最终加入狩猎队的资格属于他！

say:27:1521250020:0.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, this is abuse of power! You have to do something!
say:27:1521250020:0.male: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, this is abuse of power! You have to do something!
say:27:1521250020:0.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, this is abuse of power! You have to do something!

choice_prompt:28:1521250020.male: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, this is abuse of power! You have to do something!
choice_prompt:28:1521250020.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, this is abuse of power! You have to do something!

say:29:1521250021:0.text: Fine... I'll take the punishment. But the tryout results—
say:29:1521250021:0.source_cn: 我……我可以受罚！但是选拔的结果——
say:29:1521250021:0.male: Fine... I'll take the punishment. But the tryout results—
say:29:1521250021:0.female: Fine... I'll take the punishment. But the tryout results—

say:32:1521250022:0.text: Stop making excuses! This was your fault!
say:32:1521250022:0.source_cn: 别辩解了！本来就是你的错！

say:33:1521250023:0.text: If Solt hadn't stood up for me, and <style="stress"><player_name></style> hadn't healed me, I might've lost my leg!
say:33:1521250023:0.source_cn: 要不是索斯替我争论，还有<style=stress><...
say:33:1521250023:0.male: If Solt hadn't stood up for me, and <style="stress"><player_name></style> hadn't healed me, I might've lost my leg!
say:33:1521250023:0.female: If Solt hadn't stood up for me, and <style="stress"><player_name></style> hadn't healed me, I might've lost my leg!

say:39:1521250027:0.text: Ruu was right. You earned this.
say:39:1521250027:0.source_cn: 鲁说的没错，这是你应得的。

say:40:1521250028:0.text: Then I now declare—Solt is officially a member of the hunting squad!
say:40:1521250028:0.source_cn: 我宣布——从今天起，索斯正式成为逐影狩猎队的一员！

say:41:1521250029:0.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> bears witness. From this day on, the glory of the Wildborn is yours to carry.
say:41:1521250029:0.male: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> bears witness. From this day on, the glory of the Wildborn is yours to carry.
say:41:1521250029:0.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> bears witness. From this day on, the glory of the Wildborn is yours to carry.

say:43:1521250031:0.text: And thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, for this honor!
say:43:1521250031:0.male: And thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, for this honor!
say:43:1521250031:0.female: And thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, for this honor!

choice:28:0:1.female: You're not fit for the squad.
